question: Who among the following introduced the concept of electric field for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Michael Faraday.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Michael Faraday**__

 __
 
• He is known as the **Father of Electricity**. 
 
• He was the first who **introduced the concept of electric field for the first time.**
 
• He discovered the laws of electromagnetism.
 
• He also **discovered the induction of electric current. **
 
• He also discovered benzene in the year** 1825.**
 
• He also built the **first electric generator and first electric motor**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Blaise Pascal**__

 __
 
• He was **a French mathematician**, **physicist, inventor, philosopher, writer, and Catholic theologian**.
 
• He was a child prodigy who was educated by his father.
 
 
 
• **Joseph Henry**__
 
 
• He was an **American scientist.**
 
• He served as the **first Secretary of the Smithsonian Institution**.
 
• He was the secretary for the **National Institute for the Promotion of Science.**
